entities.summary: Vladimir Viktorovich Sakharov was a Russian general of the cavalry who served in the Russian Imperial Army. In his army career from 1869 to 1917, he served in the Russo-Turkish War of 1877–1878, the Russo-Japanese War, and World War I.
